Forest City Cycling Saturday Morning Ride

Portland, ME · Road

No-drop

Forest City Cycling Saturday Morning Ride is a road group ride in Portland, ME. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Radio Tower parking lot, behind 15 Baxter Blvd (next to Back Cove Hannaford). About 35-65 miles, 16.5-18 mph. No-drop.

For visitors

First-timers and visitors welcome. Check the club Strava page or blog for each Saturday's start. Lights if the start is dark.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 5-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Forest City Cycling Saturday Morning Ride group ride

An inclusive, moderately paced, no-drop road ride of 35 to 65 miles on a different route each week. The club calls it the Sunday drive of the weekly schedule. It is good training for charity rides and a way into group riding.
